line: 160 flocked Pips race for beans: the fast ones eat first and run dry first, and after 20 generations the board turns blue.
line_cn: 160 只植绒小人抢豆子：快的先抢到也先跑不动，跑完 20 代，整块台面都变蓝了。

camera.expresses: low close-up on one Pip (camera 1–1.3 units high, 3–3.5 away) → rise to overhead or crane to a board-wide view. Between set-ups the camera moves along a spherical interpolation around a sliding look p

camera.move: Overhead for rules and for time-lapses
camera.expresses: nearly vertical, the screen "up" fixed to the board, slowly tilting and orbiting so it never sits dead.

camera.move: Tracking at Pip height, from the side, for a race; the azimuth is chosen by code
Focus pull to hand the story from one Pip to another
Hard cuts only on rhythm points (a start, a cut into and out of a close-up); eve

camera.expresses: when a verdict or a final chart lands, picture and camera stop for at least 2.5 s.

camera.move: The key light and its shadow camera never follow the camera (no swimming shadows

transitions: Hard cuts only on rhythm points (a start, a cut into and out of a close-up);
labels: Fredoka 600 for titles and the one big number per frame (120–168 px); its rounded shapes share the Pips' character.
Inter 500/600 for explanations (24–30 px), labels and ticks; eyebrows in capitals, 15 px, letter-spacing 2 px.
Noto Sans SC 500 for Chinese, at least 34 px.
Hierarchy: each frame has exactly one largest piece of type and it is the result (a head count, a generation, a mean). Never an outline, never a drop shadow, never a header bar.
motion: Hop by distance: the hop phase is distance travelled ÷ stride (stride grows with speed); when a Pip stops, the hop amplitude fades with a smoothed "moving" factor, so feet never slide and no Pip freezes in mid-air. Lean forward 0.12–0.22 rad, squash and stretch ±8%; fast Pips kick up two or three cream fluff balls that stay where they land and shrink.

Anticipation, action, follow-through: turn and crouch before a run; the body bulges as it eats and the bean flies into the mouth; a Pip that runs out of energy slumps and fades to spent grey; at a verdict the ones that go stretch up once and shrink away (never squashed into a puddle), a newborn pops out beside its parent with a ring printed on the board.
Breathing: idle Pips breathe (±2% squash, each with its own phase), until the final hold, which is perfectly still.

Bodies never interpenetrate: in the simulation Pips are points; every frame the drawn positions are relaxed apart (three passes by body radius) so neighbours touch but never merge. This changes only the drawing.

native_moves.name: Bean rain
native_moves.does: food pops up out of the board in rings around the subject.

native_moves.name: The race
native_moves.does: a low tracking shot of one Pip running a rule, its energy bar draining.

native_moves.name: Running dry
native_moves.does: slow motion as one Pip's colour drains to spent grey and it slumps.

native_moves.name: The verdict sweep
native_moves.does: a line of judgement crosses the board; the ones that go shrink away and leave a grey ring, newborns pop up with a mint ring; the head count rolls.

native_moves.name: The morning wave
native_moves.does: between generations a mint band sweeps the board diagonally; behind it the new generation pops up, ahead of it the old one sinks.

native_moves.name: Pips into the chart
native_moves.does: every Pip walks into its slot in bars printed on the board, one Pip = one individual, with an earlier generation as a dashed outline.

native_moves.name: The cast on a number line
native_moves.does: a few Pips standing on a ramp printed on the board, each at its own value.

score.note: warm mallets and plucks; no piano-and-strings, no drum kit
